# vergeio_clusters (Data Source)

Cluster data source schema

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Clusters data source fetches the Clusters from the VergeIO. 

data "vergeio_clusters" "all" {
}
output "cluster_id" {
  value = data.vergeio_clusters.all.clusters
}

# Add a fliter to see information on a specific cluster

data "vergeio_clusters" "all" {
  filter_name = "Compute"
}
output "cluster_id" {
  value = data.vergeio_clusters.all.clusters
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter_name` (String) Filter by name

### Read-Only

- `clusters` (Attributes List) List of Clusters (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--clusters))
